apply_tag: Introductory Founder Offer · The IV Phases™
apply_headline: Four founding levels, or your own amount. One legacy, built early.
apply_body: Each level follows one of The IV Phases™ of Leadership Infrastructure™. Whatever you pay is credited in full toward a Partnership™, and Founder and Legacy Founder also include a .LLab™ product, free to keep.

tiers.description: Our highest founding level — build a legacy with us.

founder_benefits: Every founding level includes a permanent Founder Number, a digital Founder Card, a place in Founder Recognition, 20% off eligible future products from The Co.LLab™ while signed in, and everything you paid credited once toward a Partnership™, applied automatically at checkout while signed in. Founder and Legacy Founder add a free .LLab™ product, delivered to your library at checkout.
founder_not_investment: Let’s Build Your Legacy Through Omnidirectional Enterprise™. Every founding option is an investment in that legacy — it carries no ownership stake or financial return.
recognition_headline: Your name, on the wall. Permanently.
recognition_body: The moment your founding purchase completes, your name goes up on the Founders Wall, under your founding level, for good. Every Founder who helped build The Co.LLab™, remembered.
recognition_empty: The wall is ready. The first name goes up the moment the first founding purchase completes.
